public void run() {
  final int MAX_RETRIES = 3;
  int remainingRetries = MAX_RETRIES;
  boolean sendProgress = resetProgressFlag();
  while (!taskDone.get()) {
    synchronized (lock) {
      done = false;
    }
    try {
      boolean taskFound = true;
      synchronized(lock) {
        if (taskDone.get()) {
          break;
        }
        lock.wait(PROGRESS_INTERVAL);
      }
      if (taskDone.get()) {
        break;
      }

      if (sendProgress) {
        updateCounters();
        taskStatus.statusUpdate(taskProgress.get(),
                                taskProgress.toString(), 
                                counters);
        taskFound = umbilical.statusUpdate(taskId, taskStatus);
        taskStatus.clearStatus();
      }
      else {
        taskFound = umbilical.ping(taskId);
      }

      if (!taskFound) {
        LOG.warn("Parent died.  Exiting "+taskId);
        resetDoneFlag();
        System.exit(66);
      }

      sendProgress = resetProgressFlag(); 
      remainingRetries = MAX_RETRIES;
    } 
    catch (Throwable t) {
      LOG.info("Communication exception: " + StringUtils.stringifyException(t));
      remainingRetries -=1;
      if (remainingRetries == 0) {
        ReflectionUtils.logThreadInfo(LOG, "Communication exception", 0);
        LOG.warn("Last retry, killing "+taskId);
        resetDoneFlag();
        System.exit(65);
      }
    }
  }
  resetDoneFlag();
}

private void updateFileSystemCounters() {
  Map<String, List<FileSystem.Statistics>> map = new HashMap<String, List<FileSystem.Statistics>>();
  for (Statistics stat : FileSystem.getAllStatistics()) {
    String uriScheme = stat.getScheme();
    List<FileSystem.Statistics> list = map.get(uriScheme);
    if (list == null) {
      list = new ArrayList<FileSystem.Statistics>();
      map.put(uriScheme, list);
    }
    list.add(stat);
  }
  for (Map.Entry<String, List<FileSystem.Statistics>> entry : map.entrySet()) {
    FileSystemStatisticUpdater updater = statisticUpdaters.get(entry.getKey());
    if (updater == null) {
      updater = new FileSystemStatisticUpdater(entry.getValue(), entry.getKey());
      statisticUpdaters.put(entry.getKey(), updater);
    }
    updater.updateCounters();
  }
}

private long[] parseTimeRange(String begin, String end, String type) throws BadRequestException {
    long sBegin = 0;
    long sEnd = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    if (begin != null && !begin.isEmpty()) {
        sBegin = Long.parseLong(begin);
        if (sBegin < 0) throw new BadRequestException(type + "Begin must be >= 0");
    }
    if (end != null && !end.isEmpty()) {
        sEnd = Long.parseLong(end);
        if (sEnd < 0) throw new BadRequestException(type + "End must be >= 0");
    }
    if (sBegin > sEnd) {
        throw new BadRequestException(type + "End must be >= " + type + "Begin");
    }
    return new long[]{sBegin, sEnd};
}

private GetApplicationsRequest buildGetApplicationsRequest(long[] startRange, long[] finishRange, long limit, Set<String> appTypes, Set<String> appTags, Set<String> appStates, Set<String> queues, Set<String> users) {
    GetApplicationsRequest request = GetApplicationsRequest.newInstance();
    if (startRange != null) {
        request.setStartRange(startRange[0], startRange[1]);
    }
    if (finishRange != null) {
        request.setFinishRange(finishRange[0], finishRange[1]);
    }
    if (limit > 0) {
        request.setLimit(limit);
    }
    if (!appTypes.isEmpty()) {
        request.setApplicationTypes(appTypes);
    }
    if (!appTags.isEmpty()) {
        request.setApplicationTags(appTags);
    }
    if (!appStates.isEmpty()) {
        request.setApplicationStates(appStates);
    }
    if (!queues.isEmpty()) {
        request.setQueues(queues);
    }
    if (!users.isEmpty()) {
        request.setUsers(users);
    }
    return request;
}

private void validateQueue(String queueQuery) {
    if (queueQuery != null && !queueQuery.isEmpty()) {
        ResourceScheduler rs = rm.getResourceScheduler();
        if (rs instanceof CapacityScheduler) {
            CapacityScheduler cs = (CapacityScheduler) rs;
            try {
                cs.getQueueInfo(queueQuery, false, false);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new BadRequestException(e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
}

private void handleEventCommon(JobHistoryEvent event, MetaInfo mi) {
  HistoryEvent historyEvent = event.getHistoryEvent();
  if (!(historyEvent instanceof NormalizedResourceEvent)) {
    mi.writeEvent(historyEvent);
  }
  processEventForJobSummary(historyEvent, mi.getJobSummary(), event.getJobID());
  if (timelineClient != null) {
    processEventForTimelineServer(historyEvent, event.getJobID(), event.getTimestamp());
  }
  if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
    LOG.debug("In HistoryEventHandler " + historyEvent.getEventType());
  }
}

public void handleEvent(JobHistoryEvent event) {
  synchronized (lock) {
    // Setup writer if AM_STARTED
    if (event.getHistoryEvent().getEventType() == EventType.AM_STARTED) {
      handleAmStartedEvent(event);
      return;
    }

    // Write event, update summary, timeline
    writeEventAndUpdate(event);

    // Handle specific event types
    switch (event.getHistoryEvent().getEventType()) {
      case JOB_SUBMITTED:
        handleJobSubmittedEvent(event);
        break;
      case JOB_INITED:
        handleJobInitedEvent(event);
        break;
      case JOB_QUEUE_CHANGED:
        handleJobQueueChangedEvent(event);
        break;
      case JOB_FINISHED:
        handleJobFinishedEvent(event);
        break;
      case JOB_ERROR:
        handleJobErrorEvent(event);
        break;
      case JOB_FAILED:
      case JOB_KILLED:
        handleJobFailedOrKilledEvent(event);
        break;
      default:
        // No special handling
        break;
    }
  }
}
